title: Bijectivity of the universal-section cohomology map
statement: For every morphism of schemes $h:Y\to X$, every abelian sheaf $F$ on $Y_{et}$, every $q\in\mathbf N$ and every etale $W\to X$, the explicitly constructed additive map $C_{h,F,q,W}$ of [def-sbc-abelian-representable-cohomology-map] from derived Hom to $H^q(Y\times_X W,r^*F)$ is bijective. There are no additional hypotheses on $h$, $F$, $q$ or $W$.

source.place: Tag 03Q8 restricted cohomology presheaf and Tag 072W; free-representable interpretation in the docstring and restriction section of lean/WeilConjectures/SixFunctors/Etale/SmoothBaseChange/HigherDirectImage/FreeSheaf.lean

proof.text: Construct comparisonHomEquiv by composing the inverse-image/direct-image adjunction, the free/sheafification/Yoneda sections equivalence, pullback symmetry, the isomorphism between the image of the final object of T and the etale object r:T→Y, the inverse-image/localization-restriction comparison, H.equiv-zero inverse and Ext.addEquiv-zero. Naturality in the coefficient sheaf follows from the naturality of those maps. At the identity morphism this equivalence is precisely abelianRepresentableGenerator, because the adjunction hom equivalence at the identity is its unit. Therefore the ordinary Hom map f↦gamma followed by r*(f) is bijective, including empty T.

The private, fully proved extComparison_bijective lifts this Hom bijection to every Ext degree. For a general exact additive functor preserving injectives and a fixed morphism gamma:B→R(A), induction on n suffices. Degree zero uses Ext.mk-zero bijectivity. For the successor embed F in an injective I and let Q be the cokernel. The long exact Ext sequences give right-exact rows Ext(A,I,n)→Ext(A,Q,n)→Ext(A,F,n+1)→0 and Ext(B,R(I),n)→Ext(B,R(Q),n)→Ext(B,R(F),n+1)→0. Functoriality of Ext composition and of the short-exact-sequence class makes both squares commute. The additive right-exact five lemma and the induction hypothesis give the successor bijection. For r the pullback projection, injective preservation is the existing abelian-coefficient source theorem, recorded as lem-sbc-etale-abelian-restriction-injectives. All induction steps are proved in Lean; no intermediate hole is added.

The cohomology comparison map is this Ext comparison composed with abelianPlusHomExtEquiv. The latter is an additive equivalence from bounded-below derived Hom to Ext. Associativity of additive-map composition and composition of function bijections complete the proof.

Derived Hom from the free abelian sheaf on an etale representable computes cohomology of the restricted sheaf naturally under restriction
Ext of a free abelian representable sheaf equals derived evaluation on a localized site; CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext, Function.Bijective; mapExtUnit|extAddEquiv|uliftYonedaEquiv
mathlib_searches.results: LeanFinder returns Sheaf.H, cohomologyPresheafFunctor and generic Ext/resolution APIs; Loogle returns mk₀_bijective and mapExt bijections, not representable-restriction comparison. Local source reading finds the general free-sheaf and sections constructions in EtaleOpenCohomologyComparison and the exact Ext adjunction in MapBijective; the former are reused. Open-object cohomology comparison requires an open immersion and does not apply to a general etale W. The latter still needs the representable isomorphism and identification of its unit with the explicit generator.
